items.title: Amending the Transportation Code, Division II, Section 801 to establish San Francisco Police Department vehicle only parking restrictions in front of the Police Department Special Operations Center; and approving parking restriction as follows
items.text: Amending the Transportation Code, Division II, Section 801 to establish San Francisco Police Department vehicle only parking restrictions in front of the Police Department Special Operations Center; and approving parking restriction as follows: A. ESTABLISH – NO STOPPING ANYTIME, EXCEPT VEHICLES AUTHORIZED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH OR FIRE DEPARTMENT, MONDAY THROUGH THURSDAY FROM 7:00 AM TO 5:00 PM - 12th Street, south side, from Mission Street to 40 feet easterly. (Explanatory documents include a staff report, amendment and resolution. The proposed action listed above is the Approval Actions as defined by S.F. Administrative Code Chapter 31.) RESOLUTION 200602-050
